set.body: Deferred from UI-S6 (2026-09-18). The pure resolver cannot bind a ledger's rejected rows: a forger can drop a standalone rejection, or drop a record and rewrite the quarantine scope, and the ledger still resolves (pinned in LedgerForgerySuite). Add a ledger-to-source manifest relation checked in io by re-importing the source CSV bytes and comparing the resulting ledger, and include the source file as a manifest artifact.
set.title: Verify admission ledgers against their source by re-running the importer
